lines: The DEEPAL S05 is designed for drivers seeking effortless urban mobility in a compact SUV format, while still offering the space and versatility needed for weekend adventures. Its agile size and smart packaging make it ideal for navigating city streets without compromising practicality.

The E07 AWD Performance offers an elevated driving experience with 440 kW of power, 645 Nm of torque, and an impressive 3.96-second 0–100 km/h sprint. With a 510 km WLTP range, 800 V fast-charging technology, and advanced all-wheel traction, it’s built for those who demand maximum capability.

The E07 RWD delivers smooth, confident performance with 252 kW of power, a 550 km WLTP range, and rapid 30–80% DC charging in just 15 minutes. Its 800 V architecture, 6.7-second 0–100 km/h acceleration, and refined suspension make it a capable multitruck for work and everyday use.
